source: Existing tests/all26Agents.test.ts sample parameters expanded into 26 role-specific representative tasks
note: Physically inconsistent values are intentionally preserved to challenge cross-disciplinary agents; not real USV-01 baseline or naval approval

agents.task: Produce a dependency DAG outline for requirements -> geometry -> hydrostatics -> propulsion -> autonomy safety -> V&V; identify missing approvals.
Define three verifiable requirements for loss-of-link contingency, sealed-hull thermal loads, and lifting loads with traceability IDs; unknown thresholds TBD.
Describe transit at 15 knots and loiter at 6 knots as illustrative CONOPS phases, explicitly flagging sea-state, endurance and available power TBD.
Create a standards-applicability checklist for COLREG, high-speed craft, IP seals and autonomy. Flag code versions and jurisdiction unverified.
Check consistency of 10m LWL, 2.5m beam, 0.6m draft, Cb 0.45, 5.5t displacement at seawater density 1025; identify mismatch instead of silently correcting.
Determine which hydrostatic inputs and KG/GZ reference curves are missing for intact stability acceptance; compute no fabricated GZ curve.
Set up Froude-number and power-prediction validation plan for 15-knot transit at LWL 10m; identify absent wetted area and resistance references.
Define seakeeping and manoeuvring measurements needed to screen heave, pitch and roll for a 10m illustrative craft; no sea-trial certification.
Reconcile illustrative component mass ledger 1600+350+1100+150 kg against declared displacement 5500kg; identify unallocated mass and KG uncertainty.
Define structural scantling test inputs for a 10m hull, unsupported panel 450x900mm, deadrise 18deg; withhold class-compliant plating claims.
Develop sealed electronics heat balance evidence plan for 250W waste heat in an IP67 enclosure, ambient 40C; require thermal resistance and sea trials.
Calculate an illustrative gross lifting design force for 5500 kg and DAF 2, then list padeye, sling and local structure evidence needed.
Outline a propulsion matching sequence for 22-knot target speed when resistance curves and propulsive efficiencies are unverified.
Check a 48V DC architecture with 120kWh battery, 80% usable DoD, continuous load 6000+450+150+80W; label endurance preliminary.
Critique mass and hydrostatic baseline inconsistencies and test-only assumptions, and issue non-certifying challenge notices.
Specify sensor FOV, blind-zone and fusion-latency measurements to validate radar/LiDAR integration on a 10m marine craft.
Review a synthetic encounter: own course 0deg speed 15kn, target bearing45deg range2NM course270deg speed12kn; identify missing CPA/uncertainty and simulated verification gates, no actual commands.
Define a laboratory V&V campaign structure for AGT-02 including real-provider traces, solver independent benchmarks and human witness.
Propose a non-operational communications link-budget test plan for 3km line of sight, 2.4GHz, undefined antenna gains, fading and margins.
Design loss-of-link safety verification matrix, explicitly rejecting unconditional zero-thrust drift as a generally safe default.
Outline interface-control schema for sensor heartbeat, timestamp quality, link state, navigation confidence and safe-state mode; unknown timing TBD.
List FMEA hazards for battery loss, sensor dropouts, bilge leak and loss of link, using qualitative risk until severity/occurrence evidence exists.
Perform independent adversarial review of the synthetic hull dimensions, declared mass and Cb 0.45 inconsistency, and demand evidence instead of ACCEPT.
Write representative test procedure IDs for hydrostatic, resistance, autonomy and 26-agent response schema checks with measurable pass/fail conditions TBD.
Produce a conceptual Obsidian knowledge-note and wikilink organization for requirements, mass ledger and decisions; do not claim actual vault sync.
Define a public-source fleet benchmark evidence schema with source URL, timestamp, hull dimensions and confidence; do not invent vessel specifications.
